description: Direct access to Thunderbird's own Calendar/Tasks provider layer.

functions.name: listCalendars
functions.description: List enabled and disabled Thunderbird calendars.

functions.name: setCalendarDisplayed
functions.description: Use Thunderbird's native composite Calendar selector to show or hide one calendar.

functions.name: listNativeTasks
functions.description: Read tasks through Thunderbird's native task filter/recurrence engine and currently displayed calendars.

functions.name: listTasks
functions.description: Read VTODO items from Thunderbird's calendar providers.

functions.name: listEvents
functions.description: Read VEVENT items from Thunderbird's calendar providers.

functions.name: getTask
functions.description: Read one VTODO or one recurring occurrence by UID/RECURRENCE-ID from a Thunderbird calendar provider for write/read-back verification.

functions.name: getEvent
functions.description: Read one VEVENT by UID from a Thunderbird calendar provider for write/read-back verification.

functions.name: createTask
functions.description: Create a VTODO through Thunderbird's selected calendar provider.

functions.name: updateTask
functions.description: Modify a VTODO or one recurring occurrence through Thunderbird's calendar provider.

functions.name: deleteTask
functions.description: Delete a VTODO through Thunderbird's calendar provider.

functions.name: createEvent
functions.description: Create a VEVENT through Thunderbird's selected calendar provider.

functions.name: updateEvent
functions.description: Modify a VEVENT through Thunderbird's calendar provider.

functions.name: deleteEvent
functions.description: Delete a VEVENT through Thunderbird's calendar provider.

functions.name: listDiagnosticsDates
functions.description: List available per-local-date CalDAV Assistant diagnostic log files.

functions.name: diagnosticsInfo
functions.description: Return the persistent CalDAV Assistant diagnostics file location and rotation state.

functions.name: readDiagnostics
functions.description: Read the latest persistent CalDAV Assistant diagnostic lines.

functions.name: clearDiagnostics
functions.description: Clear current and rotated CalDAV Assistant diagnostics.

functions.name: writeDiagnostic
functions.description: Append a privacy-filtered diagnostic event.

functions.name: httpRequest
functions.description: Perform an HTTP(S) request in Thunderbird's privileged parent context, avoiding WebExtension CORS regressions.

functions.name: curlRequest
functions.description: Perform a local-only HTTPS REST request with explicit certificate verification bypass. Restricted to .local, localhost, loopback and private LAN IPv4 hosts.

functions.name: runWpCli
functions.description: Run the local wp executable for the configured WordPress installation. Supports one temporary uploaded file for media import.

functions.name: runWordPressHelper
functions.description: Run one supported legacy WordPress helper script (find-today-post.sh or create-post.sh) when present.

events.name: onItemsChanged
events.description: Fired when Thunderbird calendar items are added, modified, deleted or reloaded.
